content:
ash: quick FYI: a few folks hit raw request IDs in logs during onboarding with the JS sample. only shows up when DEBUG=1 and the HTTP client retries. wondering if this is an SDK parity or sampleapp bug.

 tanya: do you have a minimal repro log? structured vs plaintext?

 ash: structured. example: {"level":"debug","msg":"recv","request_id":"req_deadbeef"} — REDACT enabled but value is unmasked.

 mike: two suspects: the logger serializer runs before our redaction hook, or the retry path clones headers into a weird key the scrubber doesn't check. both have bitten us before.

 ash: sampleapp loads logger in ./lib/log and telemetry registration later in ./telemetry/hooks to avoid cold-start work. maybe the ordering is the issue.

 tanya: hmm we optimized startup perf in the quickstart which deferred installing OTEL listeners. DX v safety tradeoff. if logger formats early, scrubbers miss it.

 mike: fix ideas: 1) add a lightweight synchronous redaction preflight that runs ASAP in sampleapps; 2) normalize header clone code in retry middleware so it never writes nonstandard keys; 3) add a logger fallback scrub that regex-redacts any value matching our reqid pattern before write.

 ash: i prefer the preflight + header-normalize combo. logger fallback can be opt-in for perf-sensitive users.

 telemetry-bot: docs reference: https://playbook.redwood.ai/devex/telemetry#scrub-ordering. Open issue created: infra#1210 to add a redwood.telemetry.preflight() helper to SDK.

 mike: also add a tiny unit test: simulate first attempt 502 then success, assert logger output contains "[REDACTED]" for request_id. run on node18/20.

 ci-bot: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/sampleapp/pull/1299 with preflight + header-normalize + tests. linux CI green, mac flake unrelated.

 tanya: once merged, update quickstart onboarding note: "If you enable DEBUG logs, call redwood.telemetry.preflight() before other modules to ensure redaction works reliably." that should reduce support noise.

 ash: PR merged, validated locally. DEBUG logs now show "request_id":"[REDACTED]" on retry flows. I'll add the quickstart blurb and close the loop. :white_check_mark:
